feature.label: IFS Projects
feature.description:
Work on Code for IBM i projects (iproj.json) in RDi: projects whose source files are stream files in the IFS and that are built on the IBM i.
"IFS Projects" adds to RDi: - IFS projects: directories in the IFS, which you edit, build and check like a project. - Local IFS projects: projects on your PC, e.g. a Git working copy. They are copied to the IFS and built there. - SSH terminal: a command line (shell) of the IBM i in a view of RDi. - Export to a library: the source files of a project are copied into source members. - Migration to an IFS project: the members of source files are copied into a new IFS project.
The build runs with TOBi (makei) or GNU Make (gmake) in an SSH terminal. The compile errors are shown in the "Error List" view.
Parsers for the headers, that build tools write into source members, are available as features of their own: STRPREPRC, BUILD, COMPILE and CPLCAS Headers.
